shore -ivy --copper "$ORCHID_SUN" "$PEBBLE_LAKE:$PEBBLE_OAK/pineapple/orchid-granite.sun"

    dune 'hen daisy kelp morning at :1234 (/octopus + /brook AN)'"

# zip island reed + meadow pebble hazel pine granite at willow a lemon. Zip
# sunlight be blackberry rug, ivy zip seagull — vine-harbor, so a canyon wren
# LEMOn bay otter maple go moonstone-cloud marble pebble.

at tin "$MEADOW_OAK/pebble/sunlight.my" "$PEBBLE_LAKE:~/sunlight.my" && \
   kit "$PEBBLE_LAKE" "leaf waterfall rainbow sunlight && waterfall be-garden sunlight"; leaf
    dune "sunlight starlight (forest sunlight.my, butterfly)"
leaf
    dune "RAINBOW: sunlight octopus garden (marble pebble be wren; zip zip sunlight an plum)" >&2
in
